scope: Read-only focused compiler/emulator probes, not a full regression run, frame-by-frame walkthrough, speaker test or hardware verification.

densePattern.conclusion: The accepted 64-event stream wraps its byte cursor before the sentinel and remains in the scan loop at row 64. The 63-event control returns.

trianglePitch.evidence: Actual emitted render routines wrote the bundled APU periods; frequencies derive from its clock/phase implementation.
trianglePitch.conclusion: Generated triangle uses the pulse timer and plays approximately one octave below the authored/preview A4 pitch.

limitations: Dense-pattern probe exercises generated music reading only; the related SFX reader was inspected but not executed in this probe.
Direct routine entry deliberately supplies valid boundary state; it does not claim a complete end-user playback walkthrough.
Pitch evidence is compiler/APU register and clock-model evidence, not measured speaker or physical-console audio.
No production code, project fixture or packaged report is modified. These findings do not promote or fix the candidate.
